name: ShotLama
description: Cross-platform screenshot and screen-recording studio. The capture is the hero; chrome is graphite glass that steps aside, and one magenta accent marks intent.

sans.css: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Cantarell, "Noto Sans", sans-serif
sans.note: Platform face (SF Pro, Segoe UI Variable, Cantarell or Noto Sans): ShotLama should feel like part of the operating system.

mono.note: Bundled with meridian_ui. Dimensions, coordinates, colour values, timers and file sizes, always with tabular figures.

signature: Graphite glass over the capture (the veil), the shutter lift from selection into the Quick Access card, the Drag me grip. Annotation colours are content and never follow the theme.
